debt.description: Senior secured, junior secured, and unitranche loan positions, including revolvers and delayed draws

equity.description: Equity securities, common/preferred units, preferred stock/interests, and equity commitments

mixed.description: Issuer-only Monroe rows where the XBRL identifier lacks enough text to assign debt or equity family deterministically

known_edge_cases.description: Identifiers switched to pipe-delimited issuer and instrument family fields starting in 2025-12-31.
Some rows retain only issuer text or issuer plus a parenthetical instrument hint, so they classify as mixed leaves unless a debt, equity, or warrant term is visible.
Numeric suffixes such as issuer 1, issuer 2, and issuer 3 distinguish separate position-level tranches and are preserved in position keys.
